competency_text: Biology and computer science knowledge competencies ensure integration of knowledge of biology and computer science.
beginner: Identifies potential biological problems to be addressed by computer science techniques
competent: Determines biological problems to be addressed by computer science techniques
proficient: Evaluates the effectiveness of the selected computer science technique(s) in addressing biological problems
expert: Selects biological problems to be addressed by computer science techniques

competency_text: Biology and computer science knowledge competencies ensure integration of knowledge of biology and computer science.
beginner: Identifies computer science domains to apply to biological problems
competent: Applies computer science domains to biological problems
proficient: Evaluates computer science domains to apply to biological problems
expert: Develops new understandings of computer science domains to apply to biological problems

competency_text: Statistical methods knowledge competencies ensure application of knowledge of statistical methods for analysis of biological data.
competent: Uses simple statistical analysis to analyze trends and patterns and to draw conclusions related to the biological data
proficient: Compares findings to any related data sets
expert: Oversees selection of advanced statistical methods applicable to specific bioinformatics analyses

competency_text: Data analysis competencies ensure analysis of biological data.
beginner: Selects which existing tools and algorithms to use for any given analysis
competent: Determines options and parameters of tools to meet specified needs of a given data analysis
proficient: Implements new software tools to address unmet needs or improve current processes

competency_text: Data analysis competencies ensure analysis of biological data.
beginner: Identifies data pertinent to the analysis problem
competent: Formulates results of analyses  including information in the form of graphs  charts and tables
proficient: Interprets results within the context of the analysis problem
expert: Generates hypotheses to predict future implications based on the evaluation of data analyses

competency_text: Data analysis competencies ensure analysis of biological data.
beginner: Uses data visualization and representation tools to present results of data analyses
competent: Selects visualization and representation tools for specified bioinformatics problems
proficient: Evaluates representation and visualization tools for summarizing data analyses
expert: Modifies existing visualization and representation tools to provide insight into bioinformatics analyses

competency_text: Data analysis competencies ensure analysis of biological data.
beginner: Discusses bioinformatics with other scientists within their institution
expert: Contributes to new findings and meaningful advancements in bioinformatics through the evaluation and sharing of knowledge

competency_text: Data management competencies ensure conduct of data management  storage and retrieval.
beginner: Demonstrates basic knowledge of data structures
competent: Applies knowledge of data structures to relevant problems
proficient: Manipulates data structures to address biological problems

competency_text: Data management competencies ensure conduct of data management  storage and retrieval.
competent: Applies knowledge of data management techniques to relevant problems

competency_text: Data management competencies ensure conduct of data management  storage and retrieval.
beginner: Describes data storage and retrieval techniques
competent: Applies knowledge of data storage and retrieval techniques
proficient: Evaluates data storage and retrieval techniques
expert: Develops new data storage and retrieval techniques

competency_text: Data management competencies ensure conduct of data management  storage and retrieval.
beginner: Describe available computing resources and capacity
proficient: Manages allocation of multiple computing resources
expert: Develops new methods for allocation of computing resources
